name: Versine
long_description:
We're building consumer banking for AI agents and humans. 

To start, Versine lets your agents send and receive money, like Venmo for agents.

Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Muse or your own agent through our MCP. Here are some things that your agent can do:

1. Send money to anyone with your passkey approval to / from up to 100 people with one prompt
2. Pay people without a Versine account (they cash out to their bank in 2 minutes)
3. Transfer funds to trusted contacts without your explicit approval (you can set this)

We imagine a world where your agent can see everything you see and hear everything you hear. In that world, assistants need the ability to perform banking operations on behalf of their users and for their users’ benefit.

launches.title: Versine: Send money with AI
launches.tagline: We're building the agent-first consumer bank.
launches.body:
<https://youtu.be/J4Dmz26bTmU>

**TL;DR:** We're building the agent-first consumer bank: one where your AI agent can do everything through an MCP. We're starting with sending and receiving money. \
\
Connect Versine to ChatGPT, Claude, Muse, Instinct, or any agent and start sending money. **To celebrate our launch, and show you just how powerful Versine is, we’re giving you $100 to send to your friends, on us.**

**The problem**

Agents can already research, book, plan and buy things for us. But banking wasn't built for them. Every bank and payments app assumes a human is tapping through screens, so the moment money is involved, your agent hands the work back to you. Bolting an API onto a bank built for humans doesn't fix that; agents should have even more ability than humans do. \
\
What we imagine is a world where your assistant can see everything you see and hear everything you hear. In that world, this primitive enables more with banking than is possible today. Here are some examples:\
\
Why can’t your agent decline transactions to cancel your free trials before they renew?\
Why can’t your agent convert currency to maximize your spending power on vacation? \
Why shouldn’t rent and utility bills be split among your roommates and paid for you every month?

**The solution**

We’re starting by letting your agent send and receive money, like Venmo with an MCP. Here's what **your agent** can do with it:

* Send money to anyone with your passkey approval to / from up to 100 people with 1 prompt
* Pay people without a Versine account (they cash out to their bank in 2 minutes)
* Transfer funds to trusted contacts without your explicit approval (you can set this)

**The team**

We're Harshith, Param and Vishnu. We’ve been close friends for 10 years, and went to the University of Waterloo and University of Toronto. We’ve worked on Stripe Connect, Databricks Vector Search, and Amazon Ads.

**Our ask**

Download at [versine.com/app ](https://versine.com/app)(iOS and Android), connect your agent, and send $100 to your friends, on us.
